newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $2 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $2 - USDA.

text.p: Compared with last week's close, feeder steers and heifers steady to 2.00 higher.

Feeder Steers: Medium and Large 1 500-600 lbs 54.25-64.75, mostly 57.00-61.00; 600-700 lbs 57.00-64.90, including 76 head (Charolais Cross) 601 lbs 64.90; 700-800 lbs 57.50-63.00; package 963 lbs 58.75.
Feeder Heifers: Medium and Large 1 500-600 lbs 46.50-56.90, including 62 head (Charolais Cross) 564 lbs 56.90; 600-700 lbs few 50.50-56.00; 700-800 lbs 49.50-53.50.
